messages:
leah: Asteria Systems asked for a joint perf/W benchmark on their new ZephyrLite SoC next week. Goal: compare int4 vs int8 kernels, seq=256/512, steady-state throughput, power draw, and thermal headroom. They want both microkernel op-profiles and full inference P95 latency. Can eng-runtime + infra run this? @rohit @kevin please own the plan.

rohit: I can own. Quick checklist: we need power meter calibration (Fluke 289), firmware v3.0.4, and the kernel vectorization flags enabled. Also request Asteria share thermal enclosure spec.

maria: +1. I'll coordinate partner comms. Please include a short README for the partner describing measurement methodology and error bars. Priya (Asteria contact) asked for CSV + a short summary slide.

kevin: Built a bench image: gcr.io/redwood/bench:zephyrlite-v2. Uploaded test vectors to s3://partners/asteria/zephyrlite/2026-03-21. Smoke command: ```bash
./bench_runner --model llama-3b-int4 --seq 512 --batch 1 --concurrency 6 --iters 300 --power /dev/power0 --out telemetry.json
```Initial raw: 720 toks/s/board @6, power=82W (idle baseline 38W). No kernel patch yet.

rohit: Kernel PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kernel-patches/pull/378 6: adjusts loop unroll + prefetch for ZephyrLite. Plan: run each config with patch on/off, int4/int8, seq256/512, concurrency 4/6/8. Power sample rate = 2s. Also capture per-token latency histogram (0.1ms bins).

sam: I'll reserve rack-D test slot Tue 07:00-11:00 (PST) and Wed 07:00-11:00. Setting up automated upload to s3 and short retention (10d) for partner access. Will also spin a canary routing test to simulate a board drop and observe fallback.

maria: Couple of measurement asks from Priya: 1) include sensor calibration file, 2) attach thermal images at start/end, 3) note ambient temp. We'll add those to the bundle.

asteria-bot: build-bot: bench image zephyrlite-v2 pushed: gcr.io/redwood/bench:zephyrlite-v2 (build 2026-03-20-18) :white_check_mark: Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/78901

leah: Important: define pass/fail for marketplace listing. Suggest thresholds: sustained toks/s within 10% of baseline and perf/W >= 8.5 toks/s/W at seq512 for int4. Thoughts?

rohit: Sounds reasonable. Also flag quality regression if generation perplexity (eval set) increases >2% when switching int8->int4. We'll run a short quality eval (100 prompts) per config.

kevin: I ran a quick microkernel probe: ```json
{"board":"D1","kernel":"int4","unroll":4,"toks_s":712.4,"power_w":80.1}
```Converting to CSV and will attach.

maria: Action items:
- rohit: finalize run matrix + runbook and post by EOD (owner)
- kevin: validate kernel PR on 4 boards and upload CSVs (owner)
- sam: confirm rack reservations + telemetry pipeline (owner)
- leah: draft partner README + pass/fail criteria and slide for Priya
- maria: coordinate data handoff and marketplace checklist

Please cc Priya@asteria in final bundle and include a short note about measurement uncertainty and calibration steps. If we see thermal throttling, escalate to #eng-thermal. Thanks all :rocket:
